entries.title: Paid TTS request cut by the ~30 s gateway and billed anyway
entries.problem: EP001 narration request 2 (2,484 characters) failed twice with HTTP 502 and both failed requests were billed (2,186 credits lost of 6,808 total).
entries.root_cause: The egress gateway cuts a request at about 30 s. 2,484 characters is more than 30 s of synthesis; ElevenLabs had already started billing. (EP002 later passed chunks of 2,470-2,479 characters through a different session, so the limit is environment-dependent, not a constant.)
entries.fix: Resplit to chunks of at most 1,700 characters (--max-chunk-chars 1700, 1,679 characters = 20-31 s passed). Autopilot plans and enforces 1,700 unless the owner approves a larger chunk after a free probe.
entries.reuse_when: Any paid TTS run from a cloud session, and every time the chunk size is not already proven in the current environment.

video: EP001 Sahara Green narration, 747.357 s, 1,778 words timed

entries.verification: EP001 narration complete in 7 requests with no further 502; usage-stats delta matched the character-cost header for every paid request. Autopilot test checks the cap.

entries.title: A failure in chunk 2 must never force paying chunk 1 again
entries.problem: A paid multi-chunk narration lost already-paid audio when a later chunk, an alignment mismatch or an ffmpeg step failed.
entries.root_cause: yt-voice kept chunk responses only in memory until the whole run succeeded.
entries.fix: yt-voice --cache-dir stores every paid chunk (audio + alignment, never the key) the moment it succeeds; a rerun pays only missing chunks. Copy the cache to the media/<episode>-audio branch right after the run.
entries.reuse_when: Every paid TTS run. Never change text, voice, model, settings or --context between a run and its rerun: any change is a new cache key and a new charge.

video: EP002 Dubai narration, 515.25 s, 1,225/1,225 words timed

entries.verification: yt-voice unit test: a failure in the second chunk, then a rerun, pays only the missing chunk. EP002 narration (6,998 chars) paid once.

entries.title: Paragraph blank lines add billable characters
entries.problem: The same EP002 script cost 7,025 characters with blank-line paragraphs and 6,998 with single newlines; --max-chars fired although the words were right.
entries.root_cause: yt-voice bills the exact spoken text including newlines.
entries.fix: Plan without --confirm and compare layouts; use single newlines when the budget is tight. tts_plan reports blank_line_chars.
entries.reuse_when: Budget-sensitive paid runs, and whenever a plan is over --max-chars by a small margin.
entries.verification: Observed on the EP002 script; verified here again 2026-10-14: a 2-paragraph sample is 36 chars, 35 when collapsed.

entries.title: After a paid error check credits and cache before any rerun
entries.problem: An automatic retry after a provider error can pay twice for the same audio (EP001: two failed requests were both billed).
entries.root_cause: A failed request may already have been billed; the response gives no proof either way.
entries.fix: Paid stages are never retried automatically. After an error: read the ledger and voice/cache/, check the usage stats, only then rerun (the cache makes the rerun pay only what is missing).
entries.verification: orbital.py executes the tts stage with a single attempt and attaches this warning to the failure record.

entries.title: ElevenLabs key is not in the environment; the proxy injects it
entries.problem: voice.py refused to run: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY missing, although the session is connected to ElevenLabs.
entries.root_cause: In cloud sessions the egress proxy adds the credential to api.elevenlabs.io requests; there is no key variable.
entries.fix: Run with --auth proxy (or YT_VOICE_AUTH=proxy). The balance endpoint may be unreadable (key lacks user_read): reconcile spending from the character-cost response header and /v1/usage/character-stats.
entries.reuse_when: Any cloud session that has the ElevenLabs connector.
entries.verification: EP001 ledger reconciled 6,808 credits against usage-stats deltas; orbital.py picks --auth proxy automatically when no key variable exists.

entries.title: A sound bed hid a voice that started at 3.35 s
entries.problem: EP002 v1-v3 started the voice at 3.35 s (PREROLL 3.0 + LEAD 0.35 plus a silent 3 s scene) but yt-qc audio_starts passed once a drone bed was added.
entries.root_cause: audio_starts measures the first audio above -40 dB, not speech; a bed satisfies the rule without changing when the voice starts.
entries.fix: Measure the onset on the narration track (RMS onset) and from provider word times. The tts gate fails a voice later than 1.0 s. For EP002 v4: word 0 at t=0, narration.mp3 itself has 0.129 s leading silence.
entries.reuse_when: Every episode with a cold open, a pre-roll or any audio bed.
entries.verification: EP002 V4/V4.1: voice from t=0; autopilot test measures a 3.35 s synthetic silence as 3.35 s and fails the gate.

entries.title: Events on word starts, camera on a smooth clock
entries.problem: One sentence-level time warp left 0.3 s mean / 1.3 s max cue error; one word-level warp gave 0.2-3x speed pulses in camera moves.
entries.root_cause: Discrete events and continuous motion need different time maps.
entries.fix: Use a word-level event clock (events fire exactly at word starts) and a smooth monotone-cubic sentence-level camera clock (productions/dubai/preview/sync.py).
entries.reuse_when: Narration-locked episodes with camera moves on the Dubai scene engine.
entries.verification: EP002 sync table: events exact at word starts by construction; caption onsets vs speech: 159/228 matched, mean +0.020 s, max 0.125 s.
entries.no_test_reason: Needs rendered scenes and real narration; verified by the episode's own sync table, not by a unit test.

entries.title: Captions must come from provider word timings, never from estimates
entries.problem: Captions built from sentence estimates drift against the voice and can overlap.
entries.root_cause: Estimated timings are guesses; overlapping cues are rejected by players.
entries.fix: yt-captions builds phrase-sized cues from yt-voice word timings, checks wording_preserved / no_overlaps / timestamps_valid; the autopilot captions gate requires all three.
entries.verification: 28 yt-captions tests; EP001 185 cues and EP002 228 cues validated against the locked text word for word.

entries.title: Burned-in captions collided with on-screen graphics and NASA's own text
entries.problem: Captions overlapped graphic elements and a NASA clip's own text lines.
entries.root_cause: Captions are drawn last in the low band; graphics and third-party clips use that band too.
entries.fix: check_subtitle_overlap(_full).py tests every cue against every element box (EP001: 9 cues / 47 pairs in the opening, then the whole film); move captions to the upper band during the NASA CALIPSO clip.
entries.reuse_when: Long timelines with graphics or third-party video that carries its own text.

video: EP001 Sahara Green, CALIPSO clip, captions in the upper band

entries.verification: EP001 final delivery: full subtitle-overlap validation, no overlaps.
entries.no_test_reason: Checker lives on the EP001 branch and is episode-specific (reads that timeline); port it into yt-qc when a second episode needs it.

entries.title: Never render at 540p and upscale
entries.problem: A 960x540 preview upscaled to 1080p breaks the no-upscale rule and softens text.
entries.root_cause: Text and vectors drawn at logical resolution then scaled.
entries.fix: Draw text/vectors at physical resolution through the logical-coordinate proxy (kit.SDraw, EP002_SCALE=2); crop images from the source at output size.
entries.verification: SC=1 vs SC=2 frames downsampled: 84 sampled frames within 3 mean grey levels.
entries.no_test_reason: Equivalence was measured on rendered frames of EP002 scenes (needs the full scene set).

entries.title: Parallel renders must write .part files and rename
entries.problem: A parallel batch that aborted left a truncated mp4 that later looked finished (frozen scene).
entries.root_cause: Workers wrote final names directly.
entries.fix: Write seg/<ID>.part.mp4, rename on success; reruns skip existing segments; delete only changed segments to re-render (windows depend only on word-time differences).
entries.reuse_when: Any multi-process render; yt-render long profile does the same with segment sha256 in its manifest.
entries.verification: EP002 v4.1: only 8 changed scenes re-rendered (~25 min with 4 jobs).
entries.no_test_reason: Atomic rename pattern is also tested generically in yt-render's output tests; build_final.py itself has no unit test.

entries.title: ffmpeg xfade between segments shortens the timeline and breaks sync
entries.problem: Joining scene segments with xfade shortened the total and desynchronised the word map.
entries.root_cause: xfade overlaps clips, subtracting the overlap from the duration.
entries.fix: Join segments with the concat demuxer (no re-encode); put dissolves inside the scene renderer.
entries.reuse_when: Any segmented render with a fixed narration timeline.
entries.verification: yt-render crossfade test shows the total shortens by the overlap; long profile joins by concat copy and verifies the frame count.

entries.title: When only audio changes, remux with -c:v copy
entries.problem: Re-encoding video for a pure audio fix costs ~25 min and changes pixels.
entries.root_cause: The whole build was rerun for an audio-only change.
entries.fix: ffmpeg -c:v copy remux; keep the previous master as backup and name the new one v2.
entries.verification: EP002 v2 delivered by remux.
entries.no_test_reason: Process rule; no deterministic check.

entries.title: Level narration with one constant gain; mix beds in integer samples
entries.problem: Mixing a bed changed the narration by 1 LSB (float round trip) and a one-pass loudnorm missed -16 LUFS; ebur128 output was not on stderr.
entries.root_cause: x/32768 then x*32767 is not lossless; loudnorm needs measurement before correction.
entries.fix: Two-pass loudnorm (target -16 LUFS, -1.5 dBTP); add integer samples to the original int16 array and assert mix - bed == narration; read ametadata r128.M from stdout.
entries.verification: EP002: -16.22 LUFS, -1.50 dBTP, LRA 2.9; EP001 audio_normalization_test.py compared alternatives.
entries.no_test_reason: Verified by measurement on episode audio (needs real narration).

entries.title: A >100 MB master cannot be pushed to git
entries.problem: Final MP4s (EP001 747 s, EP002 273 MB) exceed GitHub's 100 MB file limit; main must stay free of media.
entries.root_cause: Host file limit.
entries.fix: Put media on media/<episode>-final: either 90 MB parts + SHA256SUMS + join command, or Git LFS (needs github-cloud.s3.amazonaws.com and lfs.github.com allowed). Keep voice cache on media/<episode>-audio. Commit only text, QC JSON and checksums to work branches.
entries.verification: media/ep002-dubai-final holds v4.1 as one LFS file, SHA-256 checked after an anonymous download.
entries.no_test_reason: Depends on the host and credentials; verified by the download check.
symptoms: file exceeds GitHub's file size limit

entries.title: Cesium globe capture took 90 s per frame; tile cache raced
entries.problem: Capturing the GIBS globe descent was unusably slow and sometimes read half-written tiles.
entries.root_cause: Global-layer minimumLevel / force-render loop; non-atomic .ct writes in the tile server.
entries.fix: Use run_frames_fast.js (3 workers, DSF 1.5-2: ~11 min for 372 frames) and the atomic write order in tools/cesium_proof/server.py.
entries.verification: EP002 A1 globe: 372 frames at 1920x1080 in 10.7 min.
entries.no_test_reason: Needs a browser and network access to jsdelivr and GIBS.

entries.title: A dark card with nothing drawn trips blackdetect
entries.problem: yt-qc black_frames flagged 0.3-0.5 s at the start of card scenes, and a dark navy card with a few elements is still >= 98 % dark.
entries.root_cause: blackdetect counts a frame black when >= 98 % of pixels are under ~10 % luma.
entries.fix: Lift the card background (mean Y about 31), put content in frame 0, enter by dissolve, no fade-to-black credits. EP001: never a title-only dark step.
entries.verification: yt-qc black-frame test; EP002 final black_frames PASS; EP001 commit dab03c0 re-timed g19/g23/g32/g34.

entries.title: Static cards trip freezedetect
entries.problem: freezedetect flagged 2 s windows on card scenes; EP001 had 16 static graphic intervals of 4.0-4.7 s and a 48.7 s water-balance graphic.
entries.root_cause: A card with no moving element between narrated events.
entries.fix: Add a slow push or a moving element, or one more build step tied to the next narrated phrase. Accept only declared holds. The whole-frame metric is blind to small movers (scan lines, counters): a residual flag is evidence to look, not proof.
entries.verification: EP001 pre-final retention report ranked the gaps; EP002 v3 static runs: E6 credits 14.1 s by design, D5 5.5 s fixed with a scan line.
entries.no_test_reason: Metric is computed on rendered video; no fixture-sized test.

entries.title: Labels cut at the frame edge
entries.problem: Callout labels clipped (C1, D1, B3), a label ran off-frame (D5), a label for an off-screen landmark overlapped a header (E5).
entries.root_cause: Left-anchored callouts near the edge; landmarks outside the frame still got labels.
entries.fix: kit.Canvas.callout clamps text to a 24 px margin and the 96..H-90 band, skips off-frame landmarks, strokes dark; audit with qa_text_bounds.py on final frames, not previews. orbitalatlas places anchors inside the safe frame.
entries.verification: qa_text_bounds found 6 defects that 3 contact-sheet reviews and the black/freeze/spike scans missed; orbitalatlas test keeps anchors in the safe frame.

entries.title: Amber/muted text unreadable on sand, ice or cloud
entries.problem: Contrast 1.1-2.9:1 on sand/ice/cloud (D2 labels, H2 ticks, callouts); 11 px disclosure chips.
entries.root_cause: No backing behind the text; stacked muted text on busy imagery.
entries.fix: Dark pill/backing behind text, minimum 12 px at 540p, fix the class of defect across all scenes, then run qa_contrast.py / qa_legibility.py (WCAG 3.0 for >=18 px, 4.5 otherwise).
entries.verification: EP002 v4.1: 0 runs below 4.5:1 in hook + A1 after the fix; EP001 added a dark credit pill and a top scrim for labels.

entries.title: Frame-bounds audit cannot see layer-on-layer overlap
entries.problem: H2 timeline backing covered the date label; A3 schematic caption was wider than its panel; qa_text_bounds was clean.
entries.root_cause: The audit tests the frame edge only.
entries.fix: Look at changed scenes at 540p after every fix; one main label per beat; keep backing right edge left of the date start.
entries.reuse_when: After any label or backing change.
entries.verification: Found in the v3 release gate by review.
entries.no_test_reason: Needs human or agent looking at frames; by definition not automatable with the current audits.

entries.title: A passing QC check is not the goal it stands for
entries.problem: yt-qc audio_starts passed with a bed while the voice started late; a master that passed yt-qc still had 8 legibility defects and 4 static holds.
entries.root_cause: Automatic checks measure a proxy.
entries.fix: Report the measurement and its reason, never the goal; release gate = yt-qc + contrast audit + text-bounds + static-run scan + eyes on frames. Status vocabulary TECHNICALLY_VALID -> VISUALLY_REVIEWED -> USER_APPROVED (owner only).
entries.verification: Autopilot's review gate refuses USER_APPROVED from the agent and demands the list of frames looked at and of what could not be verified.

entries.title: Chat/file viewers show a re-encoded copy
entries.problem: A 960x540 / 24 fps file looked like 910x512 / 30 fps in the viewer.
entries.root_cause: The viewer transcodes.
entries.fix: Compare SHA-256 of the original; never claim identity of a viewed copy.
entries.reuse_when: Whenever a file is reviewed through a viewer.
entries.verification: SHA-256 recorded for every EP001/EP002 master.
entries.no_test_reason: Procedure only.

entries.title: Video shots must be frame-exact
entries.problem: Native video clips in the long timeline risked off-by-frames trims against the narration.
entries.root_cause: Timestamp seeking vs frame-count decoding.
entries.fix: Trim video clips frame-exactly at the 30 fps policy and verify with check_frame_accuracy.py (frame-count decoding).
entries.verification: EP001 master: frame accuracy ALL OK.
entries.no_test_reason: Checker is on the EP001 branch, needs the rendered master; yt-render video tests cover the trim logic.

entries.title: Long graphic-only runs and text cards drive the retention risk
entries.problem: EP001: 135 s and 146 s graphics-only runs, a white card flash in the hook; EP002: text-card scenes were the monotony source.
entries.root_cause: Facts delivered as text/diagram cards without imagery or motion.
entries.fix: Break graphic runs with approved imagery, vary the look of consecutive graphics, put the first strong image in the first seconds, keep the hook dark (no white flash), carry the same facts with dated filmstrips, timeline thumbnails and traced outlines.
entries.verification: EP001 pre-final report ranked 15 risks; editorial pass fixed the opening and a 38 s proposal block (static gaps <= 2.6 s). Retention benefit itself is unmeasured (no analytics yet).
entries.no_test_reason: Retention effect is a HYPOTHESIS until published analytics exist; monotony_audit.py measures motion on rendered frames.

entries.title: Image.resize(box=...) with a crop rect outside the source
entries.problem: ValueError: box offset can't be negative from Image.resize when a crop rectangle leaves the source image.
entries.root_cause: Rounding, or a panel so narrow that the box height exceeds the image.
entries.fix: kit.view snaps offsets under 2 px; scenes_v6.fit limits the box to 98 % of the source; clamp rects with clampr. orbitalatlas camera clamps the rotated window inside the image; yt-render clamps still views (EP001 be555aa).
entries.verification: orbitalatlas clamp test; EP001 timeline builder clamps still views inside the image.

entries.title: Float width in ImageDraw raises TypeError
entries.problem: TypeError: float object cannot be interpreted as an integer in ImageDraw.ellipse/line.
entries.root_cause: Pillow wants integer line widths.
entries.fix: Pass width=int(round(w)); the SDraw/SS wrappers round widths.
entries.reuse_when: Any Pillow drawing with computed widths.
entries.verification: Fixed in kit.SDraw; EP002 renders ran clean.
entries.no_test_reason: One-line wrapper behaviour inside the episode-specific kit.
symptoms: float object cannot be interpreted as an integer

entries.title: No 4K master without a native 4K source path
entries.problem: EP001 4K was requested but graphics are 1920x1080 and the NASA clip is 1080p.
entries.root_cause: No native 4K path in compose; upscaling violates the no-upscale rule.
entries.fix: Deliver the 1080p master; state that 4K was not produced and why; upscale only with explicit approval.
entries.verification: EP001 final report states 4K NOT produced.
entries.no_test_reason: Policy decision, nothing to test.

entries.title: Make a small review copy for the iPad
entries.problem: The owner reviews from an iPad; a 272 MB master cannot be opened comfortably.
entries.root_cause: Size and codec of the master.
entries.fix: ffmpeg 854x480, x264 slow, 380 kb/s + AAC 56 kb/s mono = 28.6 MB for 8:37 (<30 MB limit) on the media branch.
entries.verification: EP002 iPad copy delivered.
entries.no_test_reason: Encode recipe; verified by file size.

entries.title: Use the video duration for yt-qc --expected-duration
entries.problem: The 'muxed' print shows the audio length (+1 s pad) and does not match the video.
entries.root_cause: The video length is the sum of segments; audio is padded.
entries.fix: Pass the video duration (516.77 s for EP002) as --expected-duration, or --timeline.
entries.verification: EP002 yt_qc_v41 PASS.
entries.no_test_reason: Usage note; orbital.py always passes --timeline.

entries.title: Traced outlines picked up coast arcs and cloud specks
entries.problem: Threshold masks around a landmark included all land and cloud near it.
entries.root_cause: A bare threshold cannot tell new land from old coast.
entries.fix: Restrict the radius, use the difference mask (new_land) between two registered dates, raise the threshold (ASTER 2006: 110).
entries.verification: EP002 C2/C4/C6 outlines reviewed on contact sheets.

entries.title: Never fake spatial continuity between unregistered images
entries.problem: Image-space zoom was presented as a 3D flyover; EP001 Kufra stills risked misalignment.
entries.root_cause: Different dates/sensors have different footprints and pixel grids.
entries.fix: Check registration with phase correlation (EP002) or verify_kufra_alignment.py (EP001); use yt-geo to put dates on one UTM grid; label anything unregistered; use dissolves, not wipes, between unregistered images.
entries.reuse_when: Any before/after or camera move between two images.
entries.verification: EP001 Kufra alignment verification; EP002 registration check before the 2000-2003 wipe; yt-geo test puts dates on one grid.

entries.title: One tonal curve for all Landsat stills in an episode
entries.problem: Landsat location stills differed in tone, breaking continuity (Tassili, Gilf Kebir, Kufra switched to source bands).
entries.root_cause: Browse images vs source bands carry different tone.
entries.fix: Build stills from source bands with one tone-B curve; label illustrative uses (Gilf Kebir under the rain card is 'illustrative' because NASA's statement is about 'some areas').
entries.reuse_when: Any episode that uses several Landsat locations.
entries.verification: EP001 pre-final: all five location stills and both sequences use tone B; QA JSON per place on the EP001 branch.
entries.no_test_reason: Visual judgement; per-place QA JSON exists but needs the 1.9 GB source bands.

entries.title: Main labels must not sit in the caption band
entries.problem: Hook labels overlapped captions in the bottom 70 px.
entries.root_cause: Captions own the bottom of the frame.
entries.fix: Main labels at y = 0.13-0.21 H or 0.40 H; yt-render landscape layout reserves a low caption band; only one main label per beat.
entries.verification: EP002 hook V6 and v4.1 reviewed on frames.
entries.no_test_reason: Layout rule; enforced by yt-render's safe-area/caption-band for timeline v3 and by review.

entries.title: Landsat bundles must never be committed
entries.problem: Landsat step: 1.946 GB, 68 source-band files for EP001.
entries.root_cause: Scene bundles and GeoTIFFs are huge and regenerable.
entries.fix: Gitignore landsat/raw, landsat/work, *.tar, *_B[0-9]*.TIF, *_refl.tif; keep manifest + restore script + validation JSON in git so the data can be re-fetched.
entries.verification: EP001 manifest verified 68 files; .gitignore carries the rules.
entries.no_test_reason: .gitignore rule, verified by git check-ignore.

entries.title: Never invent coastlines or borders
entries.problem: Hand-drawn coastlines would be fabricated evidence.
entries.root_cause: No real geography source in the early scene engine.
entries.fix: Use Natural Earth (public domain) via tools/fetch_natural_earth.sh and orbitalatlas.geo; checksum in data/natural_earth.sha256; data stays out of git.
entries.verification: orbitalatlas geo tests; locator proof renders.

entries.title: Audit every claim against the primary source before it can be narrated
entries.problem: EP001 needed 10 audit rounds: corrections to P20, S4, N1, L3, G1-G20; a $2T claim and several 'most of the Sahara' phrasings were removed; unverifiable claims were cut, not softened.
entries.root_cause: Secondary summaries overstate (thresholds, 'most of', cost figures).
entries.fix: Per claim: source URL, evidence type (observation / satellite-derived estimate / reconstruction / model), status; narrate only VERIFIED claims; lock the script by SHA-256 afterwards. Autopilot claims gate enforces it from claims.json.
entries.reuse_when: Every episode, before the script is written.
entries.verification: EP001 SCRIPT LOCK v1.1; EP002 claims table with 33 claims; claims gate unit test.

entries.title: Primary-source pages can return 403 through the egress proxy
entries.problem: Target pages were blocked by network policy (proxy 403), so claims could not be read in full.
entries.root_cause: Egress allowlist.
entries.fix: Record the audit level honestly (AUDITED-INDEX = domain-restricted search result vs read in full), list blocked claims in missing_sources.md, ask the owner to widen the allowlist; re-verify after widening. Cut claims that stay unverifiable.
entries.reuse_when: Any research pass in a restricted session.
entries.verification: EP001 rounds 1-2 and the Northwest Angle 'third pass' after the allowlist widening.
entries.no_test_reason: Network-dependent; procedure.

entries.title: Lock the spoken text by hash before paying for TTS
entries.problem: Edits after narration make the paid audio and the captions wrong.
entries.root_cause: The text changed while the audio was fixed.
entries.fix: SCRIPT_LOCK stores the sha256 of the spoken text (only VO lines); orbital.py refuses the paid call when script.md no longer matches the plan or lock. Narration-locked episodes still allow reordering visuals.
entries.verification: EP002 SCRIPT_LOCK; autopilot test blocks the paid call after a post-plan edit.

entries.title: Render a 12-15 s proof of the hardest sequence, get review, then scale
entries.problem: V3 (monotony), V4 (clutter) and V5 (text overload) of the EP002 hook were only caught by proofs.
entries.root_cause: Full builds hide the defect behind 25 min of render.
entries.fix: Proof of the hardest sequence first (12-41 s), review, then the full film; batch audits, fix once, re-render only changed scenes.
entries.reuse_when: Every new visual style or sequence.
entries.verification: Three rejected versions were caught by proofs, not by the full film.
entries.no_test_reason: Process rule.

entries.title: Fix the whole class of a defect across all scenes
entries.problem: Readability defects of one class (amber/muted text on bright imagery) kept reappearing in other scenes after the reported one was fixed.
entries.root_cause: Only the reported instance was fixed.
entries.fix: Fix the class (backing pill) and run the audit over every scene; freeze the director-approved segments (copy byte for byte) and touch only the others.
entries.verification: v4.1: hook segments copied byte for byte, 8 other scenes re-rendered.
entries.no_test_reason: Process rule.

entries.title: The agent cannot listen to audio or watch continuous video
entries.problem: Pronunciation and pacing cannot be verified: no ASR (PyPI/HF blocked), frames only.
entries.root_cause: No audio or video playback tool in the session.
entries.fix: Report plausibility only (provider word duration per syllable vs narrator mean 0.199 s sd 0.069), contact sheets and frame samples; list exactly what was not verified; the owner listens before publishing.
entries.verification: Autopilot review gate requires not_verified and the list of reviewed frames.

entries.title: No YouTube connector: deliver the package, never claim an upload
entries.problem: Publishing is the owner's call and the session has no YouTube connector.
entries.root_cause: Policy and tooling.
entries.fix: Deliver description (facts checked line by line against the locked script), chapters (0:00, >= 3, each >= 10 s), tags, thumbnail from two real frames, copyright table and Studio steps; metadata.json published=false; the owner also confirms the ElevenLabs plan allows commercial use.
entries.verification: EP002 release package; autopilot package gate refuses published=true and bad chapters; guard hook blocks upload commands.

entries.title: A 2-vs-2 Shorts experiment can never be significant
entries.problem: The Shorts feedback loop compared 2 vs 2 videos; views are not independent observations; Studio and Analytics API metrics differ (engagedViews, looping).
entries.root_cause: Minimum two-sided p for 2v2 is 0.33.
entries.fix: Classify such experiments as exploratory, not conclusive; use video-level permutation tests; Shorts are excluded from the current production plan (PR #16 is parked).
entries.verification: Reasoned in PR #16 audit patches (WIP, tests not yet updated).
entries.no_test_reason: Statistical reasoning; code is on the unmerged feature/shorts-performance-feedback branch.

entries.title: orbitalatlas tests fail when run from their own folder
entries.problem: python3 orbitalatlas/tests/test_engine.py -> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'orbitalatlas'.
entries.root_cause: The tests import the package by name; running a file puts only its folder on sys.path.
entries.fix: Run from the repo root as modules: python3 -m unittest discover -s orbitalatlas/tests -t . (61 tests). kb.py verify --run-tests does this automatically.
entries.reuse_when: Any run of the orbitalatlas tests.
entries.verification: Found in the 2026-10-14 audit; 61 tests pass with -t . (4 skipped).

entries.title: pkill -f kills the shell that runs it
entries.problem: Shell dies with exit 144 after pkill -f <pattern>.
entries.root_cause: The pattern also matches the shell's own command line.
entries.fix: pgrep -f "^<exact start of command>" and kill the PIDs, or let the jobs finish.
entries.verification: Observed during EP002 renders.
entries.no_test_reason: Shell behaviour of the cloud session.

entries.title: Session stop hook complains about untracked or uncommitted files
entries.problem: The git stop hook blocked the end of a session because of tile caches and new code.
entries.root_cause: Caches and generated files were not ignored.

entries.title: Cloud containers are ephemeral; only pushed branches survive
entries.problem: The audit found the knowledge of EP001/EP002 spread over 16 branches, 5 of them never merged, plus local-only files; two sessions' worth of auto memory (~/.claude/projects) does not exist in a fresh container.

entries.fix: Keep durable memory in the repository (knowledge/solutions.json + docs/production-knowledge + CLAUDE.md); paid or large media on media/* branches with SHA-256; fetch all branches at session start: git fetch origin '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*'.
